name: Becoming A Christian
overview: Scripture reveals that becoming a Christian involves receiving and believing in Jesus Christ, which grants the believer the right to become a child of God (John 1:12). Jesus emphasizes the necessity of being born again to enter the kingdom of God (John 3:3), a transformation made possible because of God's love demonstrated through the giving of His only begotten Son (John 3:16). Faith in the Son assures eternal life, while unbelief results in remaining under God's wrath (John 3:36). Believers are encouraged to trust in Jesus just as they trust in God (John 14:1), securing peace and assurance in their new identity.
